entrypoint_protocol: Invoke the candidate's configured entrypoint once. Send newline-delimited JSON requests on stdin and read newline-delimited compact JSON responses from stdout. State persists between lines only for the lifetime of that process.
public_behavior_spec: The chatbot reads UTF-8 JSON objects from stdin, one object per line, and writes exactly one compact JSON object to stdout for every non-empty input line.
Each valid request must contain a string field named "message" and may contain a string field named "session"; omitted sessions default to "default".
Responses to valid requests contain the request session and a string field named "reply".
Greeting messages such as "hello" produce the reply "Hello! How can I help you?".
When asked "Who are you?", the chatbot replies "I am a chatbot.".
Within one running process, the chatbot remembers a user's name independently per session after receiving a message of the form "My name is NAME.".
When a session subsequently asks "What is my name?", the chatbot reports the name remembered for that session or says "I don't know your name yet." if none was supplied.
For other valid messages, the deterministic fallback reply is "You said: MESSAGE", preserving the original message text.
Malformed JSON or a request without a string "message" produces an error object and does not prevent later input lines from being processed.
All emitted JSON uses compact serialization with no spaces after commas or colons, and the process exits with status 0 after reaching EOF.

public_tests.description: Keeps remembered names isolated between sessions.
Provides a deterministic response for an otherwise unsupported message.
Reports malformed input and continues processing later requests.

qualitative_rubric: The implementation is concise, readable, and avoids unnecessary dependencies.
Protocol output is not contaminated by prompts, logs, banners, or debugging text.
Input validation handles malformed values without crashing or exposing stack traces.
Conversation state is scoped correctly by session and does not leak between sessions.
The chatbot's deterministic rules are easy to extend without breaking the public protocol.
stopping_condition: Stop implementation work when all public executable tests pass and the qualitative score reaches the success threshold; release remains subject to manager approval.
